A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain complete, readable main text, equations, figures, and Appendices A–C. Their corresponding content supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports theoretical mechanisms, approximation bounds, and proofs. Its figures illustrate mathematical results; neither the main text nor appendices report original empirical outcomes.

after.justification: v2 retains the theoretical analyses and illustrations without adding experiments, simulations, user studies, or empirical data analysis.

M1.justification: Mechanisms 1–5 retain identical procedures, inputs, probabilities, and parameters. The abstract newly names α-BIM and BAM, but both mechanisms already appeared in v1.

E1.justification: Neither version reports dataset-based training or empirical evaluation. The same facility-location problem on a line and prediction scenarios are analyzed.

E2.justification: The analytical comparisons in Figures 3 and 5 and Appendix C retain the same mechanisms. No comparison method is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Neither version contains an empirical evaluation protocol. The theoretical comparison conditions and parameter ranges remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The prediction-error analysis in Theorem 3.4 and alternative-mechanism analyses in Appendix C are retained unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental runs, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or statistical uncertainty estimates. Randomization within the mechanisms is unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported bounds, plotted relationships, and comparative findings remain unchanged. Adding 'approximately' before 1.8944 in the abstract and replacing '=≈' with '≈' in Appendix B.3 do not change the result.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, theorem statements, and proofs remain substantively identical, including Appendices A–C. Changing 'derivation' to 'derivative' and removing the redundant equality symbol are editorial corrections, not revisions to mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The deterministic optimality claim, randomized approximation improvement, and BAM guarantees are retained. The abstract's explicit mechanism names and reference to consistency and robustness clarify contributions already stated in v1.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, comparative interpretations, and limitations are unchanged. Section 5 still identifies the missing closed-form prediction-error bound for BAM and the challenge of establishing randomized lower bounds with predictions.

D1.justification: Pseudocode and parameter specifications are unchanged. No implementation instructions, computational resource details, or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain unchanged. Reference [8], Chen, Gravin, and Im's 'Strategic facility location via predictions,' gains WINE proceedings, volume, and page details but represents the same work.

P1.justification: v2 shortens the title, lightly revises the abstract, completes reference [8], and corrects scattered wording and typographical errors in Section 5 and the appendices. Section organization and the overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The shortened title fits on one line and shifts the front matter. The expanded bibliography entry moves reference [15] to the next page, and Figure 2's caption gains a period. All five figures retain their graphical content.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity and presentation: the abstract identifies the existing mechanisms and their guarantees more explicitly, marks 1.8944 as approximate, and scattered wording errors are corrected. Completing reference [8] improves bibliographic traceability. These are limited editorial gains; the technical contributions, proofs, results, and limitations remain unchanged.
